# Solver Scaling — Quality

*Measurement pending.*

This page will publish, per tool, the largest grid size at which the tool still closes at least 90% of the quality gap between a uniform-random selection and the best-known solution within the one-minute reference budget — alongside the per-size gap-closure fractions and the best-known-solution provenance table. The definition and measurement method are pinned by the [protocol](protocol.md).
